title: Fleet

help.title: About fleet
help.overview: Each vehicle belongs to a category and has a home location. Only active vehicles are rented out.

sections.title: On this page
items: A vehicle with upcoming bookings can't be set to maintenance or retired, or moved to another category, until those bookings are moved to another car.
Retire a vehicle instead of deleting it: its history stays on past bookings.
